name: tree_genome
reason: Trees need a species description shared by all four tree systems (design/systems.md, Trees). One structure, nested in the other tree channels, keeps the rig, mesh, and colouring reading the same numbers; ranges in the schema drive the UI's genome sliders. Draft revision (2026-10-11): channels renamed to tree_<feature>; foliage gains fronds (palms) and bark gains ringed (palms) and papery (birch), for the tropical and northern species.
